# Phase H V3 contract fixtures

**NON-AUTHORITATIVE TEST SNAPSHOT.**

These fixtures exercise the frozen H0-G candidate schemas. Runtime code must never load this directory as contract authority. Canonical candidate contracts live under `schemas/` and `docs/data_capabilities/`; current production authority remains V2 until a later activation is authorized.

`contract_examples.json` contains deterministic H1, H2, H3, H4, and Request V3 examples. It contains no live source payload and requires no network access.
